description: This file defines a PHP class 'Reward' which extends a controller in the OpenCart system. The class manages reward points functionalities such as displaying reward points info, saving reward points, and handling related API requests within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class for managing reward points in the OpenCart framework, including display and save functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays reward points information to the user, including available points, and provides links for saving reward points and proceeding to checkout.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save or remove reward points, updates session data accordingly, and returns JSON response with success or error messages.
